authorization.publication: No merge, deployment, release, automerge, active configuration migration, global installation, or recurring spend

scope: Execution and delegated autonomy: reuse existing contracts, states and receipts; preserve approved scope, criteria, reviewers and user-reserved actions; technical evidence cannot be human acceptance; do not change acceptance or auto-pass a specialist; stale artifact evidence must be rerun.

GitHub recovery: bind writes to the exact target and expected head/revision; use leases/preconditions when actually available; re-read before writes/retries and read back after; ambiguous or inaccessible remote state preserves local work and never creates duplicate objects; no automerge/merge/deploy/release/spend.

Proportional governance: route specialists by surface and risk; TRIVIAL work uses an inline contract without the ten-sector matrix; mandatory security/data/contracts/UI checks remain non-waivable when triggered; preserve source/decision/plan separation and existing catalog provenance.
Register new executable utilities in Linux, Windows and macOS Environment catalogs with platform-specific validation status.

Implement opt-in derived context smaller than its canonical source set, from exact excerpts only; record source and plan references/SHA-256 and UTF-8 byte measurement; compare curated positive cases against original and derived content; test removal of an exception and inversion of a negation; source/plan change invalidates; absent or failed evidence falls back to the original; hashes/schema never prove semantic equality; secrets are excluded.

Implement deterministic rendering of the existing Task template; code controls static text and replaces only schema-allowlisted fields; validate type/size/enum/pattern/range; escape by destination; preserve protected decisions/criteria and static bytes; reject missing/extra/invalid fields with no partial output; values are data and one-pass only; atomic write/rollback on failure.
Validate byte-preservation, Unicode, special characters, repeated fill, missing/extra/invalid values, changed sources, removed exceptions and inverted negations.
Document limits, opt-in adoption, method for measuring context/artifacts/interventions and fallback; do not claim unmeasured savings.

Preserve Windows-native/WSL/Linux boundaries, compatibility gates, stored preferences, stable runtimes and lifecycle ownership; do not change active settings, installed caches, credentials, other repositories, or external data.
Do not install or incorporate Rig, Agentics, gh-aw, Evergreen, Goal, Autoloop, Crane, CAO or WikiKB; no benchmark was approved or run, and no recurring service/dependency is added.

acceptance_criteria: Derived context retains exact selected source excerpts and source hash/revision, is opt-in, fails closed on stale sources, and provides the original source on failed retrieval evaluation.
Positive and negative retrieval controls detect missing exceptions and inverted negations; hash/schema checks are not presented as semantic evaluation.
Template rendering substitutes only allowlisted, validated fields in one pass, escapes destination content, preserves static bytes, and leaves no partial output on failure.
Atomic writes and repeated rendering are deterministic; invalid/missing/extra fields fail with clear errors.
No edits to active host config, installed caches, credentials, remote state, or unrelated TASK-055.
